about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. Ordering, dependencies and effort (working days) for XC-79 to XC-84, an addendum to the cover-all plan (XC-54 to XC-78, pull request #80). Nothing here is binding; each task becomes part of the contract only when the owner merges it into proofline.json and re-signs it. XC-51 to XC-53 and XC-54 to XC-78 are signed first.

tasks.title: Dexter: the open-source build of a hosted facilitator as a self-hosted column
Hosted-only facilitators: documented out-of-reach rows and an operator-permission track
Coverage decisions recorded by the owner: no exclusions; live settle on Solana devnet and Base Sepolia, fixtures for Canton, Lightning and mainnet-only defaults, a Starknet Sepolia path
Spec traceability: every check classified as normative (a spec clause) or hardening (beyond the spec)
An offline CI job template another repo can paste in: no wallet, no funds, no secrets
Yank x402-conformance 1.3.0 and 1.3.1 on PyPI, with a reason pointing to 1.4.0
